movies.overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
movies.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption

movies.overview: After a criminal network kidnaps Wang Wei's daughter and the corrupt police refuse to assist him, Wei sets out on his own to locate her. Navin, a tenacious journalist whose wife has mysteriously vanished, is his only ally. In this explosive martial arts showdown, the unlikely duo fights the kidnappers ruthlessly driven by a furious vengeance.
movies.tagline: To save their loved ones, they will fight everyone.
movies.title: The Furious

movies.overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.
movies.tagline: Hey Frank.
movies.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill

movies.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
movies.tagline: An offer you can't refuse.
movies.title: The Godfather

movies.original_title: คนเดือดทวงแค้น
movies.overview: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.
movies.tagline: A debt can be settled, but not erased.
movies.title: The Debt Collector

movies.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.
movies.tagline: Some men just want to watch the world burn.
movies.title: The Dark Knight

movies.overview: A man living in self-imposed exile on a remote island rescues a young girl from a violent storm, setting off a chain of events that forces him out of seclusion to protect her from enemies tied to his past.
movies.tagline: Her safety. His mission.
movies.title: Shelter

movies.overview: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

production_companies.name: iQIYI Pictures （重复 同 iQiyi Motion Pictures）

movies.tagline: He's training a new generation of law enforcers for a dangerous mission to save the world from ruthless criminals.
movies.title: The Shadow's Edge

movies.overview: In a quiet village, charming young Tomás leads a simple life: caring for his mother, working at the video store and town clinic, and collecting dolls. As women begin disappearing, newly arrived Inspector Porter investigates.
movies.title: The Dollmaker

movies.overview: An Italian-American woman traveling to Sicily picks up a teenager who claims to be in trouble with some drug dealers.
movies.title: Woman in the Moon

movies.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
movies.title: Facing El Chapo

movies.overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three stories that ingeniously trip back and forth in time.
movies.tagline: You won’t know the facts until you’ve seen the fiction.
movies.title: Pulp Fiction

movies.overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.
movies.tagline: An action film inspired by real events.
movies.title: Citizen Vigilante

movies.overview: The story of Takeha, a free-spirited genius poet who lived through Taisho Romanticism, and the women who gave themselves over to his ambitions.
movies.title: Modori River

movies.overview: Estranged half-brothers Jonny and James reunite after their father's mysterious death. As they search for the truth, buried secrets reveal a conspiracy threatening to tear their family apart.
movies.tagline: They fight like brothers. They wreck like legends.
movies.title: The Wrecking Crew

movies.overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.
movies.tagline: Paul Edgecomb didn't believe in miracles. Until the day he met one.
movies.title: The Green Mile

movies.overview: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.
movies.tagline: The rise and fall of the Corleone empire.
movies.title: The Godfather Part II

movies.overview: When reclusive Franklin cheats on his partner with a mysterious girl he meets on a dating app, it becomes the start of a deadly obsession.
movies.tagline: An erotic thriller for the Tinder generation.
movies.title: Graphic Desires

movies.overview: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on Wall Street, corporate banking world and mob infiltration. Based on Jordan Belfort's autobiography.
movies.tagline: Earn. Spend. Party.
movies.title: The Wolf of Wall Street

movies.overview: A veteran inmate takes a newcomer under his wing as the pair confront both other violent inmates and the prison's corrupt wardens.
movies.title: Prison on Fire

movies.overview: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.
movies.tagline: The legend ends.
movies.title: The Dark Knight Rises

movies.overview: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.
movies.tagline: Gluttony. Greed. Sloth. Envy. Wrath. Pride. Lust.
movies.title: Se7en

movies.original_title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
movies.overview: Some of Sin City's most hard-boiled citizens cross paths with a few of its more reviled inhabitants.
movies.tagline: Walk down the right back alley in Sin City and you can find anything...
movies.title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For

movies.overview: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.
movies.tagline: Unmask the truth.
movies.title: The Batman

movies.overview: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.
movies.tagline: The night is young. He isn't.
movies.title: 72 HOURS

movies.original_title: Nando Entre Dois Mundos: Um Filme Sintonia
movies.overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.
movies.title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film

belongs_to_collection.name: The Fast and the Furious Collection

movies.overview: Over many missions and against impossible odds, Dom Toretto and his family have outsmarted, out-nerved and outdriven every foe in their path. Now, they confront the most lethal opponent they've ever faced: A terrifying threat emerging from the shadows of the past who's fueled by blood revenge, and who is determined to shatter this family and destroy everything—and everyone—that Dom loves, forever.
movies.tagline: The end of the road begins.
movies.title: Fast X

movies.overview: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.
movies.tagline: Put on a happy face.
movies.title: Joker

movies.overview: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.
movies.tagline: Always have an exit.
movies.title: Crime 101

movies.overview: Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past.
movies.tagline: Some search for battle, others are born into it...
movies.title: One Battle After Another

movies.overview: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.
movies.tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.
movies.title: GoodFellas

movies.overview: Determined to prove he's the world's greatest supervillain, Gru hatches an audacious plan to steal the Moon. To pull it off, he adopts three orphaned girls—Margo, Edith, and Agnes—intending to use them as pawns in his scheme. But the unexpected bond they form forces him to question the criminal life he's always known.
movies.tagline: Superbad. Superdad.
movies.title: Despicable Me

movies.overview: With the price on his head ever increasing, John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.
movies.tagline: No way back, one way out.
movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 4

movies.overview: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.
movies.tagline: Burn it all down.
movies.title: Scream 7

movies.overview: Léon, the top hit man in New York, has earned a rep as an effective "cleaner". But when his next-door neighbors are wiped out by a loose-cannon DEA agent, he becomes the unwilling custodian of 12-year-old Mathilda. Before long, Mathilda's thoughts turn to revenge, and she considers following in Léon's footsteps.
movies.tagline: If you want the job done right, hire a professional.
movies.title: Léon: The Professional

movies.overview: Levon Cade left behind a decorated military career in the black ops to live a simple life working construction. But when his boss's daughter, who is like family to him, is taken by human traffickers, his search to bring her home uncovers a world of corruption far greater than he ever could have imagined.
movies.tagline: Human traffickers beware.
movies.title: A Working Man

movies.overview: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise. While an undercover cop curries favor with the mob kingpin, a career criminal rises through the police ranks. But both sides soon discover there's a mole among them.
movies.tagline: Cops or criminals. When you’re facing a loaded gun, what’s the difference?
movies.title: The Departed

movies.overview: John Wick is forced out of retirement by a former associate looking to seize control of a shadowy international assassins’ guild. Bound by a blood oath to aid him, Wick travels to Rome and does battle against some of the world’s most dangerous killers.
movies.tagline: Never stab the devil in the back!
movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 2

movies.overview: A young schoolgirl, Yuen Fong becomes caught in a tragic stranglehold of triad activity after she testifies in court over a triad beating. When this news reaches the triad leader Brother Smart, Yuen Fong must pay him protection money for what she has done as events begin to escalate.
movies.title: School on Fire

movies.overview: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.
movies.tagline: The truth behind a perfect marriage.
movies.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman

movies.overview: A woman’s lover and her ex-boyfriend take justice into their own hands after she becomes the victim of a rapist. Because some acts can’t be undone. Because man is an animal. Because the desire for vengeance is a natural impulse. Because most crimes remain unpunished.
movies.tagline: Time destroys everything.
movies.title: Irreversible

movies.overview: Held in an L.A. interrogation room, Verbal Kint attempts to convince the feds that a mythic crime lord, Keyser Soze, not only exists, but was also responsible for drawing him and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro harbor – leaving few survivors. Verbal lures his interrogators with an incredible story of the crime lord's almost supernatural prowess.
movies.tagline: Five criminals. One line up. No coincidence.
movies.title: The Usual Suspects

movies.overview: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
movies.tagline: He loved the American Dream. With a vengeance.
movies.title: Scarface

movies.overview: A talented piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.
movies.tagline: Everybody has one hidden talent.
movies.title: Tuner

movies.overview: Llewelyn Moss stumbles upon dead bodies, $2 million and a hoard of heroin in a Texas desert, but methodical killer Anton Chigurh comes looking for it, with local sheriff Ed Tom Bell hot on his trail. The roles of prey and predator blur as the violent pursuit of money and justice collide.
movies.tagline: There are no clean getaways.
movies.title: No Country for Old Men

movies.overview: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.
movies.tagline: Count the money. Count it again. Count on no one.
movies.title: The Rip

movies.overview: The now-reformed Bad Guys are trying (very, very hard) to be good, but instead find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes, globe-trotting heist, masterminded by a new team of criminals they never saw coming: The Bad Girls.
movies.tagline: Back in badness.
movies.title: The Bad Guys 2

movies.overview: A true story about Frank Abagnale Jr. who, before his 19th birthday, successfully conned millions of dollars worth of checks as a Pan Am pilot, doctor, and legal prosecutor. An FBI agent makes it his mission to put him behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.
movies.tagline: The true story of a real fake.
movies.title: Catch Me If You Can

movies.original_title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
movies.overview: The original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists to take on powerful diamond heiress Veronika Vanderberg, who leads a criminal empire built on money laundering and trafficking. The new and old magicians must overcome their differences to work together on their most ambitious heist yet.
movies.tagline: Unlock the illusion.
movies.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
